# Use Markdown Architectural Decision Records

## Context and Problem Statement

We want to record architectural decisions made in this project, in a form that lives beside the code (see #12).

## Considered Options

* MADR 3.0
* Wiki pages

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: "MADR 3.0", because it is plain text in the repository.

### Consequences

* Good, because decisions are reviewed like code.
